newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Six killed in Nigerian clash, agency says.
newsitem.headline: Six killed in Nigerian clash, agency says.

text.p: Six people including a senior police officer were killed and several injured in a clash between herdsmen and farmers in the northeastern Gombe town, the national news agency reported on Monday.
Two policemen were among other victims receiving treatment from injuries they sustained from poisonous arrows used in the clash, Adekunle Adekoye, the police commissioner in the area said.
He did not say when the clash occurred nor what caused it but said calm had returned to the area after more policemen were drafted there to maintain peace and order.
Clashes between farmers and nomadic cattle rearers are common in the semi-arid north and are usually triggered by herdsmen grazing their animals on farmlands.
